Lakers 124Trail Blazers 118

Luka 53, Lakers stay perfect this week

Final · Fri, Nov 6 · Los Angeles

Portland hit 19 threes and led at the half. Luka Dončić answered with 53, and 24 Blazers turnovers did the rest.

1 · First half

How it started.

The Trail Blazers led 29–20 after one quarter. At the half, the Trail Blazers led 60–53.

Scroll to keep going ↓
2 · The difference

Luka got to the line all night

53 points on 17-of-33 shooting and 14-of-18 free throws.

3 · How it turned

The third quarter flipped it

The Lakers won the third 34–15 to turn a 60–53 halftime deficit into a 12-point lead.

4 · Where it was won

Turnovers beat threes

Portland made 19 threes but turned it over 24 times. The Lakers scored 28 points off them.

5 · Final

Lakers 124, Trail Blazers 118.

Q1Q2Q3Q4F
POR29311543118
LAL20333437124

From the Trail Blazers’ side: Lost the third quarter 15–34, then won the rest of the game 43–37.

What it meant: the Lakers are 11–2, 1st in the West, with 87% top-6 odds now. The Trail Blazers are 8–3, 5th in the West, at 53%.

2 · The play of the game

The dagger.

Dončić's jumper in the lane with 28 seconds left that put the Lakers up six.
